description.text:
The second Expansion Sheet series, the red one, released on 17 June 1998: 36 cards on eighteen numbered sheets of three, sold with cardboard damage counters and coins.

Japan's Expansion Sheets, which collectors call the Vending Series, were sold from vending machines as random sheets of glossy cards to peel off. Each series is split into six places in Kanto, and every numbered sheet always holds the same cards, which match its place. Red's six places run from Rock Tunnel and the Power Plant to Cinnabar Island, with the Legendary birds Articuno, Zapdos and Moltres among the cards. Some of the cards later came out in English as Wizards Black Star Promos through the 2001-2002 Pokémon League.
